name: Blot
legendaryAbilityText: This planet's influence value is increased by 1 for each of your control tokens on this card, and its resource value is increased by 1 for each control token on this card that belongs to another player. This card cannot have more than 6 control tokens on it.
legendaryAbilityFlavourText: The record of those we have deemed worthy.
flavourText: *Even the record of our conquest shall one day be consumed.*
